## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected and how often?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you would like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why did you rule them out?

## Additional context

Links, mockups, prior art, or anything else that would help us understand the request.
